answer: Require each agent to post a refundable stake before it can influence the registry, then let independent peers issue a small, unpredictable pulse of tasks and score the resulting signal against the agent’s history. A kernel of peers can quarantine identities whose answers diverge or whose stake is repeatedly slashed. Creating many Sybils then requires locking real capital in every identity and risking losses across them; the attacker cannot cheaply multiply votes just by minting accounts.
